Tokiko Fuuma is a main character in Taimanin Asagi Battle Arena and recurring in the online games.

She is a Taimanin of the Fuuma clan. As the daughter of Fuuma Danjo, she is Kotaro's older half-sister. Tokiko is the stewardess of the clan and second in command, but always loyal to Kotaro.



Personality
Tokiko is a polite young woman, that is totally loyal to Kotaro, in good and bad times. She is diligent and very friendly, but can be demanding, making sure that Kotaro does not become lazy. Tokiko has a constant watchful eye over the Fuuma clan or Fuuma Organization and is an expert when it comes to information gathering and financing.

As second in command, she does counter Kotaro's more evil tendencies somewhat, nudging him as his older sister at times. Tokiko is polite to even her enemies and liked by most of them, but can trick people to get what she wants or help Kotaro. When both were young, she addressed him as "young master", while she calls him "my lord" when he got older.

After her rescue events in TABA, she demands assertive, that Kotaro needs to treat her really rough in bed and use her as his "sex swine". That version always loved Kotaro, which refused any such contact, until he thought he earned her.

Tokiko gets easily jealous of Kotaro and give him stern looks, that seem almost more effective than Kunai. That jealousy also shows itself to anybody that wishes to take her spot as a steward.

Appearance
She has black short hair, and turquoise eyes. She has a black battle suit, with yellow patterns.

Early on in her youth, she wore a white battle suit with a black skirt and blue patterns.

Later on in her late teens, Tokiko wore more blue and purple, with a small cape.

History
Fuuma Tokiko Young
Background
A Taimanin of the Fuuma clan. Born of a concubine of Fuuma Danjo, in year 2058, she is the oldest known child of Danjo. Tokiko has multiple half siblings including, Fuuma Kotaro, Fuuma Ginrei and Nisha Gaiza.

As soon as she was born, Tokiko became part of the main family of the stewards, who has served Fuuma's family for generations, in Fuuma Village. Danjo himself never treated her like a daughter but did see her value as a ninja, her mother, was sold later off into slavery by Danjo, and her fate is unknown. Tokiko was adopted and raised by another male Fuuma member, which later died at an unknown point in her early life.

Tokiko trained under the main stewards like Fuuma Saika, which overlooked most of the Fuuma clan finances and operations right below the clan head Danjo. Tokiko was on her way to become the next steward as well given her accomplishments early on. Tokiko is praised as the Fuuma family's strongest kunai user, and her close-combat abilities were regarded as the greatest among the Fuuma clan. Unlike Kotaro, she was able to use the Evil Eye, the characteristic ability of the Fuuma family, early on in life but exceeded the most in supportive or covert operations. Since the young Tokiko was that skilled, she was often sent to dangerous missions or overlooked the clan but was always viewed as expendable. While, given so much power to a child was viewed as unusual, and looked down upon by the conservative parts of the clan, it was tolerated because of the merit driven system that Danjo followed.

Tokiko even around that time held some level of power in the Fuuma clan, as a future "steward", holds the most power within the clan next to the clan chief. She interacted with many members of the Fuuma clan, including Fuuma Gisuke, Sago Bungo, Fuuma Amane and had a level of authority over them. While, she often was viewed as nagging and she had her minor conflict with the wild Amane or cold Bungo, she was still respected by people with skill.

Tokiko was offically assigned as the guardian of Kotaro, the theoratical heir of the Fuuma clan if Danjo would die. Both became, friends thanks to Kotaro's strong animosity towards their father, unlike others he viewed Tokiko as family and not a tool. For the first time, respected and loved, Tokiko promised to protect Kotaro no matter which path he would choose. As the Fuuma Revolt under Fuuma Danjo began in the year 2068, the young Tokiko did not join it and instead protected Kotaro from the fighting.

Fuuma Tokiko Young 3
Even after the defeat of Danjo and victory of Gosha Village, which could end in Danjo fleeing or dying, Tokiko remained at Kotaro's side, regardless of Fuuma Danjo Loyalists wishing for her to join them. Both Tokiko and Kotaro, remained in Gosha for some time, with Kotaro going to Gosha Academy, and becoming friends with people like Isozaki Inori and other left over clan members like Amamiya Shisui. Tokiko herself took up the mantle of Kotaro's fragmented Fuuma clan's steward and would watch over, depending on timeline, she and Kotaro were either alone in the effort of clan reconstruction or had the help of other clan members which remained.

As part of the Fuuma clan, split, and had joined the UFS, both her and Kotaro were not always treated the best. In her young, adult period around 2076, she Tokiko changed her outfit to be more revealing, something she later called a bit of a rebellious phase, which some tease her over, even years later.

She made experience, during that time for missions in Gosha and had fought together with the Onmyoji, Shiki Reika. During Reika's time in the GSDF, with them being close in age. Tokiko and her had became close friends, a friendship which would hold regardless of Tokiko's allegiances shifting in some timelines. Helped by the Fuuma clan and Shiki clan having close ties, Reika would often act almost like an older sister.

During some missions, it is possible she had befriended Meiya Ultauna and Rosie Mochimoi, while investigating a destroyed research base and saving their lives.

Before the year 2082, Tokiko was on her way to also become possibly a teacher in Gosha but her allegiance in the end depended on Kotaro.

Timeline TABA
Fuuma Tokiko 6
Both Tokiko and Kotaro, have a smaller age gap and are overall older. It is unknown when Tokiko is born in that timeline.

When both her and Kotaro were younger, she was ordered by Danjo to "comfort" Kotaro, but he refused. Wishing to take things by his own hands and not given by somebody he hated, he told Tokiko that he would steal her from his father when the time came. Something, which she remembered and left her impressed.

Tokiko, Kotaro and Amamiya Shisui were old friends in their childhood but had in later years interacted little. She and Kotaro were both abandoned after the Fuuma Revolt 2068, in which Tokiko protected Kotaro. Danjo took most of the Fuuma clan to the UFS under Task Force G rule, including the clan steward Fuuma Saika, which made Tokiko the new steward of the new clan her brother was building within his new Fuuma clan at times called the Fuuma Organization. While, slightly unclear on details around this time, Kotaro still finished Gosha Academy and befriended people like Isozaki Inori. However, after his training was complete and he awoke to his own Evil Eye ability, he escaped from Gosha Village, and now was opposed to the Taimanin, UFS and Demons.

In the year 2082, Tokiko took care of financial and information gathering, Tokiko was Kotaro's true confidant in the Fuuma Organization. Tokiko collected the information about the next targets, but also accompanied Kotaro on many missions. Often she is seen to be jealous or correct Kotaro's more brutal actions with her sharp gaze, but typically supports him no matter what.

Tokiko, was captured by Rengyou Azami on a mission, in which she tried to recover Maezono Momoko in Tomihara. Given to Azami's contact the ruler of Tomihara the Dark Witch Miryu, Tokiko suffered humiliation forced to remain nude, and forced to follow the orders of Miryu and Saya NEO, which had been manipulated by Miryu to follow her. Before, suffering any serious "game" that Saya NEO thought, up, Tokiko was rescued by Fuuma Kotaro (TABA) and assistance of the DSO, with Koukawa Asuka and the Masked Taimanin.

During a mission, Kotaro is unable to leave Tokyo Kingdom, being attacked by the UFS, Io Orion and the Fire Squad Unit of the Taimanin, lead by Kamimura Maika. Tokiko seeks out the help of her old friend Shiki Reika, part of the Onmyoji. Though Reika states, she can fight the UFS forces operating illegally, she cannot attack the Taimanin, as both Onmyouji and Taimanin belong to the Japanese govermnent. Regardless of the current criminal status of Tokiko, Reika agrees to help and either fights her way or delays the Taimanin with talk, for Kotaro and Tokiko to overcome and capture both Io and Maika.

In another event, Tokiko and Kotaro, while looking for a Philosopher's Stone become part of a plot, of the UFS, in which they are forced to cooperate with Annerose Vajra, Neu Eazlane and Igawa Asagi to close an Otherworld Gate. Thanks to everybody, the world could be saved with the destruction of the gate.

While on vacation with Reika and Kotaro, Tokiko gets angry, as she sees a Sakura (ZERO) from another world, which has been kept a secret. As Tokiko and Shiki Reika rush after Kotaro. He is forced to obey an order of Edwin Black and deal with Revenant Knights of the Corpse Lord growing power. As the assistance, Red Line, that Kotaro got on that mission turns on him, Tokiko, Sakura and Reika arrive in time to save him. Sakura had explained the situation, and her guest status.

In the year 2083, Tokiko, become friends with Neu Eazlane and asks her for chocolate, which contains a love potion for Kotaro, on her quest to get back she gets attacked by both Oboro and Igawa Asagi independently. While Oboro wants the chocolate to cause trouble, Asagi is worried that Tokiko or Kotaro try to perform some evil act with it. Oboro is captured by Neu, and Tokiko is able to feed Asagi a piece of chocolate, which forces Asagi to flee because of the effect on her body. Returning with most of the chocolate, in the end Kotaro is able to dodge eating it, as he gets suspicious and switches them out. Leaving Tokiko confused, but still satisfied as he seemed to like the chocolate.

Tokiko makes Angers her replacement, should something happen to her, with Murasaki (ZERO) another world version of Murasaki also showing promise. Tokiko kills one of the Brain Flayer, Arsal, in one event. It used its power against the Masked Taimanin and Sakura (ZERO), in another event. While it first it tried to get asylum Arsal proved to be rather evil.

Fuuma Tokiko 10
Around this time, Tokiko is kidnapped by by her half sister, Fuuma Ginrei for their father, the returning Danjo. Forced to be a slave and trained by her father's subordinate Fuuma Gisuke, as a trap for Kotaro. This is unnoticed because Tokiko is replaced by a Doppelganger, and in later events is put in charge of a base in Amidahara. As an attack of the Corpse Lord forces of Wight, kills the Doppelganger brutally thinking it is Tokiko, Kotaro discovers that Tokiko has been missing and starts a search for her, which takes months, using his allies in the DSO. As Kotaro learns, that Task Force G uses a Incubus Faction base as they are allied, he creates a distraction to break in himself, while the others keep Danjo, Incubus King and G forces occupied.

During the months of torture Tokiko's mind almost had broken fully, living as a pet of Gisuke. However, as Saika was defeated outside and Ginrei was killed by Kotaro, she was able to recover mentally somewhat as they escaped. After Kotaro brings her home, she swears loyalty once more and demands to be his personal "swine", also to fulfill the promise that Kotaro made to her when they were young. Both have sex with the first time and hope to deal with Danjo directly soon.

In the year 2084, Tokiko calls Kotaro, which faked a business trip to relax with Natsume Sayoko and Fuyuno Reiko. Learning, that two Doppelgangers were after him and Danjo was on his way to attack him, Kotaro was able to defeat them and capture Fuuma Amane on his own. On another mission, both Tokiko and Kotaro follow a possible trace to find Danjo using the Ryomanin. Both Yomi Akitsu and her guard Gran, are however, tricked to fight Tokiko and Kotaro, while Saika manipulated what both parties from the shadows. As the trick of Danjo is fully discovered, Saika is knocked out and captured.

As Kotaro and Tokiko, get closer to Danjo, in a confrontation in one of his hideouts with him, Tokiko is controlled thanks to the Evil Eye and brainwashing still in her mind from the dead Gisuke. To heal Tokiko, Kotaro uses his doctor Kiryu Mikoto's Psycho Dive leaping into Tokiko's mind. Defeating, Tokiko's shame, she is able to fully recover. Danjo is later on killed by Kotaro, which results in Nomad now keeping a close eye on him.

Fuuma Tokiko 5
Kotaro and Tokiko, are suprised by a small Taimanin Squad under Shiga Asatsuki, which had been sent out under the direct orders of the prime minister. As they defeat the group, all of them are taken out by the arriving Kaliya and brought to the NEO Chaos Arena. Tokiko is forced to fight Asatsuki to the death, while Kotaro and the others are able to escape their cells and defeat both Asatsuki and Kaliya, escaping the place. Nothing but a test, of Edwin Black and Kaliya as later confirmed.

In the year 2085, the former Task Force G assassin Asagi (Clone), has been mentally released from brainwashing. However, as she investigates an illegal online arcade, she connects back to the G network and goes berserk. While, able to hold her down, Kotaro and Tokiko are able to cut the connection, as Tokiko uses her Ninja Art to enter Cyberspace. As Sakura (ZERO) is captured by Fürst of Nomad, Tokiko is united with Amamiya Shisui which Kotaro requested to deal with Fürst. Fürst is in the end defeated, with the Fuuma Organization gaining much influence.

Tekkain Kaworu, part of a lower branch of the Nisha clan, all former families under the Fuuma clan tries to take over the Fuuma Organization, having learned about the recent actions but feeling still not impressed by Kotaro. Tokiko is able to fight back against Kaworu, and her allies, while Kotaro is captured during that time. In the end, Tokiko and the others are able to overcome Kaworu and force her to flee.

Tokiko is attacked in another event by Fuuma Saika, which had escaped after Danjo's death, while Amane which had also given up her fight, Saika remained deeply loyal. Tokiko challenged her to a one on one dual, and in the end Saika was defeated, with Tokiko understanding her grief over Danjo, as she would feel the same if Kotato had died. To be left alone, Kotaro agrees that Saika, will be given to Gosha forces which had arrived at the scene, with Tokiko and Kotaro escaping.

In the year 2086, things escalate, as Amamiya Shisui is gravely hurt and falls into a coma, after an attack of Felicia. Forced to leave her behind in the hands of Igawa Asagi's medical teams, with Tokiko and Kotaro escaping a trap of Nomad. Saika, which escaped from the Taimanin, thanks to the demon Chaos Order, for the last time tries to attack Kotaro, this time using the DNA of Danjo to gain a transformation. However, Tokiko and Kotaro are able to defeat her, at which point, she is able to go past her grief and accepts Kotaro as the clan head and Tokiko as steward.

Kotaro is captured by Oboro, during a mission with Mizuki Yukikaze, which turned out to be a trap. Yukikaze is able to inform the others, and a united force of Taimanin, DSO, Fuuma Organization and demonic allies attack the headquarter of Nomad. Tokiko is almost killed by a regenerated Fürst but saved by the intervention of Amamiya Shisui, which had separated her soul from her body to help in the fight. During, the fight against Edwin Black, Tokiko is knocked back as Kotaro uses Asagi's body to fight Black.

As the TABA Reset occurs, Tokiko is seen in the prologue world and other universes created like AT or RPGX Universe.

Timeline RPGX
Fuuma Tokiko 3
As the Fuuma Revolt failed and her father Danjo died in that timeline, she remained with Kotaro in Gosha Village.

Tokiko, assisted in the guardian duties of Fuuma Kotaro and Nisha Gaiza. She often came into conflict with the wild Fuuma Amane or needed to break up fights between her and others.

When the revolt failed in the year 2068, the Igawa clan under orders of the elders, was in strong pursuit of 11-year-old Tokiko, which tried to flee with Kotaro on her side. Karasuno Ryoma was sent by more radical members of the elders to kill any members of the Fuuma clan, regardless if they had given up. Tokiko almost died in their fight but was saved by Igawa clan heir, Igawa Asagi, which gave all Fuuma clan members which put down their weapon protection.

Tokiko pushed for peace between the angry fragmented clan and Gosha Village, supporting Igawa Asagi that wished for the clan to remain in the village. She and Kotaro remained in the Fuuma Estate, with Tokiko once more becoming the steward of the clan as Fuuma Saika retired after the death of Danjo.

In the year 2070, the Igawa Revolt, a civil war-like internal conflict between Igawa Elders and the head of the clan, resulted in the death of the clan head Igawa Shuzen. As Hattori Seishu of the elders also wanted to kill her granddaughter Asagi, other clans (Koukawa clan, Yatsu clan, Mizuki clan) jumped to her support, members of the Fuuma clan, including Tokiko joined in the fight against the elders as well, because of their past conflict with the elders and current support of Gosha.

Fuuma Tokiko Summer
In the year 2073, February 14, the Koukawa Massacre took place, in which forces of Corpse Lord Teutates almost killed the entire clan in order to gain access to an artifact. Tokiko, Asagi and Mizuki Shiranui were in the end able to rescue at least Koukawa Asuka from the fires and the leftovers of the leaving forces.

Around her early adult years 2076, she took a mission from Mizuki Shiranui, which acted as temporary headmaster. Seeing child Mizuki Yukikaze, she felt slightly inadequate even though she had been a child prodigy herself, but was told that while "strength" is important her daughter still lacked control and skill unlike Tokiko. On the mission itself, Tokiko befriended Meiya Ultauna and Rosie Mochimoi, while investigating a destroyed research base and saving their lives. Thanks, to their united teamwork, they were able to disable to computer system which overlooked a out of control OZ unit, which they were able to destroy. Most of these events and her name was kept a secret.

Tokiko becomes later on a teacher at Gosha Academy, something both Tokiko and Kotaro struggle with at times. As Taimanin RPGX begins in year 2082, she is 24-25 years old.

While not playing a big role, compared to TABA, she appears often supportive to characters like Library, Fuuma Amane, Fuuma Saika and Izumo Tsuru, which she treats like family. At the beginning of the new year 2084, she returned to gosha and celebrated, together with other Fuuma clan members. In the year 2087, she agrees with the idea of Kotaro to support Library and Izumo Tsuru to connect, with a vacation in Atami.

Timeline Action
Fuuma Tokiko 7
Follows some of the RPGX events but is its own timeline.

Additionally, the high quality of her lunch boxes, was what motivated Noah Brown to join the Taimanin Task Force in Action Taimanin. The OZ mission from RPGX, is canon here and she befriended Meiya Ultauna and Rosie Mochimoi.

Tokiko also trains together with Fuuma Saika, when nobody notices, as both fear that their abilities are rusty. During one spring cleaning, she found her old uniform, and began fantasising about going on missions with her master if they were of closer ages, strongly implying she sometimes dream of having sex with him.


Powers/Abilities
Tokiko Ultimate
Main Weapon: Kunai

Ninja Art: "Evil Eye", "Clairvoyance" allows her to separate her vision from her physical body and send it off to wherever she may choose, allowing her to essentially sneak into any location. Even if unaware, this is a form of astral projection. The flying orbs, sometimes seen around her, could be visualizations of her eyes out-of-body vision.
While her ability is in effect, by simply having her sight touch books, computers and so on, she can read the information contained within. She needs to know the writing of the book or data to understand it, and her hacking abilities are not as good as the more specialist experts.
Gravity View: Is able to see the center of gravity and other aspects of attacks and objects, and can block them if observed. It is possible that her air jumps, as seen in Action Taimanin, may be connected to this. With this, she is also able to move her flying Kunai in ways, which defy physics.
Can also see the vision of multiple attackers.
Thousand Eyes "Hyakki Yagyō": the secret hidden power of her Evil Eye Clairvoyance if awoken to this skill, it allows her to summon eye patterns in the air, from which she can release countless kunai.
Illusion Guardian: Casts a large illusionary guardian, which covers her target in fire. The effect can create shock in the target but is not real, with most skilled enemies able to recover.
Particle Control: Taimanin are able to manipulate Taima Particles to enhance their physical strength, speed and defense. The particles are also used to counter demonic influences and strengthen damage to demons.

Trivia
The fact that she is part of, many half siblings is confirmed in a Comiket 87 data book.
The tag "Criminal Taimanins" and "Independent Taimanins" only apply to her TABA version.
Her mother might or might not be, still alive, as she was sold.
Her ultimate attack in Action Taimanin, seems to be a reference to both Fate and Persona.
Furthermore, her skill as a Taimanin is lower than people like Sakura or Asagi. In TABA she would be required to avoid a direct fight and prefer to attack from the side. However, would gain abilities on the same level of Fuuma Saika.
The "job" of Stewardess or Steward for Taimanin means something closer to "House Guardian or clan guard". Secretary, maid and responsible for money, they are the highest ranked member next only to the clan head.
Tokiko in RPGX is about 8 years older than Kotaro. The age gap is much smaller in TABA.
Etymology
Tokiko means "time, hour, occasion" (時) (toki) and "child" (子) (ko).
